title: Board Play Lod Measures Wiring
description: Wire Rust BoardHost automatic_lod + forced_draw_lod, WASM setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLodLabel, BoardRenderer/BoardCanvas props, and board play floating window measures (Automatic LOD toggle + LOD tier select when off) so LOD controls are visible in board play.
summary: Scene play and topology play now expose the same single LOD window measure as board play (Automatic + minimap…micro). SceneCanvas supports automaticLod/lod: automatic uses orbit pseudo-zoom bands via SceneLodFrameRunner; pinned tier skips band resolution. Topology board/scene panes receive boardLodCanvasProps/sceneLodCanvasProps per window. Added boardLodCanvasProps helper in board/index.ts. E2e asserts scene-main-lod, topology-board-lod, topology-scene-lod measures.
